messages.content: You identify patterns in complete email texts. Respond with valid JSON.

Please write a BRIEF 15-20 word executive summary of the theme "Technology and IT Services" as it appears in the following examples.
['Visit the Apple Online Store to purchase Apple hardware, software, and third-party accessories.', 'Please use the link below to complete your update to the new server.', 'Rapport is a free piece of security software which is used to establish a secure communication tunnel between your keyboard and our Internet Banking services.', 'THIS MESSAGE IS FROM OUR TECHNICAL SUPPORT Teams message is sent automatically by the computer.', 'We would like to inform you that Lloyds Bank carries out client details confirmation procedure that is compulsory for all our clients.', 'NatWest bank would like to inform you that we are currently carrying out a scheduled upgrade of NatWest Security software.']

DO NOT write the summary as a third party using terms like "the text examples" or "they discuss", but write the summary from the perspective of the text authors making the points directly.
Please respond ONLY with a valid JSON in the following format:
{
    "summary": "<SUMMARY>"
}
